info.description:

        Further details goes here

post.description: Create a new register definition and null register schema record.

Edit an existing register definition.
If the register has data, only mnemonic and description can be edited.
Delete a register definition if it has no data.
Get all registers for dashboard display (clone of get_all_registers)
Get register schema configuration for a given register_id.
Update an existing register schema configuration for a given register_id.
Update the dedup_is_enabled flag for a register.
Update the dedup_threshold_score for a register.
Update the deduplicate_schema for a register.
Update the search_result_schema for a register.
Get all sections for a given register_id.
Get all sections for a given register_id and tab_id with pagination.
Add a new section for a given register_id.
Delete a section by section_id.
Update a section's metadata (not including UI schema).
Update a section's UI schema.
Get UI schema for a specific section.
Get all UI tabs for a given register_id with pagination.
Add a new UI tab for a given register_id.
Delete a UI tab by tab_id.
Edit an existing UI tab.

Get the history records for a given register, internal_record_id and tab_id.
Returns all historical versions of the record, ordered by approved_at descending.

Get unique truncated dates from history records for a given register, internal_record_id and tab_id.
Returns a list of unique dates (YYYY-MM-DD format) based on created_at of history records.

Get changes from history records for a given register, internal_record_id, tab_id and specific date.
Returns a list of change_request_id, section_id, section_mnemonic, and created_at.
Get deduplication results for a change request against register records.
Get deduplication results for a change request against other change requests.

post.summary: Get Schema Definition For Register Section
post.description: Get schema definition for a specific section of a register.

Get records from a section register that are linked to a subject record.
Traverses the master-child hierarchy between registers.
If subject_register_id == section_register_id, returns the subject record directly.

Get all records for a tab, grouped by unique section_register_id.
Multiple sections with the same section_register_id are deduplicated.

post.summary: Get Allowed Parents For A Child Section
post.description:
Get allowed parent records for a child section.
Given a subject record and a child section register, finds the parent register
of that section and returns all records from the parent register that are linked
to the subject.

post.summary: Get Number Of Pending Change Requests
Get Number Of Cross Register Changes
Get Register Change Request Summary Data
Get Subscription Activity Logs By Partner

post.description: Upload multiple documents to MinIO storage with the specified document label.

Get documents for a section record.

Returns the list of documents (label, document_store_id) for the specified record and section.

Get documents for a change request.

Returns the list of documents (label, document_store_id) attached to the specified change request.

Get the URL for a file.

Returns the URL for the specified file.

post.summary: Get Deduplication Intake Form Register Results
Get Deduplication Intake Form Intake Form Results
Create Change Request For Core Data
Approve Change Request For Core Data
Reject Change Request For Core Data
Get Ideal Completion Score For Register
Get Ideal Completion Score For Section
Get Computed Completion Score For Section
Get Computed Completion Score For Record
